classes.name: Regional elections
classes.note: Counted per region: each regional council election counts once. The 15 ordinary-statute regions' elections since 1970 come from the Interior Ministry's historical archive (Eligendo). Sicily, Sardinia, Aosta Valley, Trentino-Alto Adige, and Friuli-Venezia Giulia elect their councils under their own statutes, and Eligendo doesn't list them; of these, only the Aosta Valley elections since 2003, from the region's own results pages, are counted so far. Neither are four ordinary-statute elections that Eligendo leaves out: Marche in 2020 and 2025 and Molise in 2018 and 2023.
